study: F2 WP2.3 slice 1 - two-way range station bias solve-for in BLS-LM (MEAS-08, X-15 bias part)
source_of_predeclaration: docs/assurance/vv-program.md F2 table (WP2.3 row); plan section 9 design 2026-11-03
scope_slice_1: estimate_two_way_range_bls_lm(bias_mode='station_range'): one constant range bias per station of the pass, data-only, eliminated exactly by variable projection (Golub-Pereyra; the bias enters linearly with a constant design column): residual and Jacobian rows of each station have their a-priori-weighted station mean removed, so the LM loop, its acceptance test and the posterior (the Schur-complement marginal of the orbit state) are unchanged in form. The bias estimates are reported in EstimatorStats.station_range_biases_m. Moon-centred and barycentric (two_way_light_time_ssb) passes alike
out_of_scope_slice_1: robust outlier rejection with bias (fails closed)

G1_bias_recovery.rule: noise-free data with known biases +7 m (station 1) and -4 m (station 2): recovered biases within 1 mm

G2_state_recovery.rule: position < 1 cm from an 80 m / 0.02 m/s offset, on the same data

G3_bias_free_model_misfit.rule: the same data fitted without bias_mode leaves a station-mean residual within 2 m of the injected bias on at least one station (evidence the bias is material)

G4_projection_identity.rule: on unbiased data, bias_mode='station_range' returns biases < 1 mm and a state within 1 cm of the bias-free solve

G5_fail_closed.rule: SRIF with bias_mode, bias_mode with solve_for_k_srp, with robust_outlier_rejection, and unknown bias_mode values are rejected; a pass with a single station row is rejected

reject_if: any gate fails as computed, or a frozen default-path baseline changes
scope_slice_1b: estimate_two_way_range_srif(bias_mode='station_range'): the same variable projection in the SRIF residual, scored cost and posterior design; SRIF no longer fails closed for this mode (G5's SRIF clause is superseded by G6)

G6_srif_parity.rule: on the G1 data SRIF recovers the biases within 1 mm and its state agrees with BLS-LM within 1 cm; SRIF and BLS-LM posterior position sigmas agree within 1 percent
